link_navigation.answer: yes, and it needs a deliberate configuration change because the stock behaviour is inverted

html_anchor_label_method.finding: the documented <a href> inside a node label needs htmlLabels true; under the recommended configuration it produces no anchor at all, which also closes the remote-image vector

measured_loose.finding: loose restores custom schemes but also re-admits javascript: URLs into the href, so it is not usable

measured_strict.finding: securityLevel strict strips the user's own local note link and keeps the remote one, which is backwards for this product

link_navigation.question: may a click directive reach a notrios:// note link, so a diagram navigates to the user's own notes and the user decides about any remote URL from there

root_cause.mechanism: the default ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP permits http, https, mailto, tel and similar but no custom scheme, so notrios:// is dropped while https:// is kept
root_cause.verified_fix: adding notrios to ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP restores the href; javascript: stays blocked with and without the change

recommendation.bundle_budget: load mermaid only when a diagram is present, via dynamic import
recommendation.failure_presentation: always show the fenced Mermaid source; never an empty box
recommendation.link_policy: allowlist the notrios scheme, neutralise remote schemes, keep javascript and data refused; securityLevel stays strict and htmlLabels stays false
recommendation.renderer: mermaid 11.17.2, pinned exactly and bundled locally
required_configuration: maxEdges lowered to the product bound
maxTextSize lowered to the product bound
required_post_processing: sanitise the produced SVG before insertion
extend the sanitiser's ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP to admit the notrios scheme, so a diagram can link to the user's own notes
drop or de-link every remote href and xlink:href, so a diagram cannot navigate off the machine; the user reaches a remote URL from the note it is written in, where they can read it first
keep javascript: and data: refused by both the URL sanitiser and the DOM sanitiser
resolve a notrios:// click through the in-app stable-link resolver rather than browser navigation
refuse script, iframe, foreignObject, and on* attributes
catch every throw, including internal TypeErrors, and fall back to fenced source
recommendation.rollback: restore noMermaid: true in web/src/editor-assets.ts; no data or schema is involved
recommendation.superseded_note: an earlier draft of this recommendation said to strip every href. That would have removed the product's own note links while leaving nothing useful, and it misread which layer was dropping them.
recommendation.verdict: enable in H2, with the containment design below

status: complete investigation; recommendation issued, no production change
